picked: D-FINE, Apache-2.0, BF16, N to X tiers
why: Unconditional license keeps the weights in the operator's hands; N through L fit the 48 GB card; ahead of DEIM on matched compute in the July 2026 comparison.

picked: 48 GB PCIe inference GPU class server in the ASHRAE A2 conditioned server room, N+1
why: The entry class for plant server rooms running vision, and retrospective search plus 80 to 120 streams of decode fit it with headroom for a second model.

picked: Frigate NVR v0.18.0 with its built-in ONNX detector runtime
why: Open source the operator owns outright; keeps 30-day retention, ONVIF and RTSP exits and local detection without per-camera license rents.

picked: Fixed multi-sensor thermal and visible heads, no wireless radios, Section 889 screened with producer-of-record statements
why: Zone coverage needs always-present calibrated views, and camera provenance is the first procurement gate on a test site.

picked: Managed PoE switches over underground single-mode fiber, two strands per pole
why: The requirement fixes the fiber architecture, and PoE Type 1 and 2 per-port budgets cover the heads without pole-side power electronics.

picked: NEMA-rated outdoor enclosures, 277/120/24 V step-down transformer feeds, Network UPS Tools for clean shutdown
why: Heat, storms and sun angle degrade heads and light budgets, and clean shutdown protects the archive.

picked: OCP Time Card GNSS grandmaster with holdover oscillator, Chrony 4.9, linuxptp where PTP-aware switches exist
why: Evidentiary ordering across 80 to 120 recorded streams requires one clock.

picked: Keycloak on-premise single sign-on with hardware token sign on for Linux hosts
why: Only booth operators and the safety office reach the isolated network, under the operator's identity policy.

picked: Prometheus, Grafana and Loki on the isolated network
why: Camera uptime must be a first-class metric, not a vendor health page.

picked: The survey evidence pack, pixels on target first, low light as a budget, mounting geometry decides what you see
why: Coverage is proven in phase one evidence, never assumed from a camera count.

picked: A site-scale camera onboarding reference architecture and an on-premises video search blueprint
why: Onboarding, clip retrieval and search patterns adopted with no managed cloud, keeping the audio visual core on-premises.
